answer.description: Your own answer to the question in the brief, in a few sentences.

confidence.description: high only when you checked the key facts yourself.

findings.description: The facts your answer rests on, each with its evidence.

location.description: File and line, e.g. src/api.ts:42, a command, or 'general'.

evidence.description: What you read or ran that shows it. Say when it is inferred rather than checked.

unchecked.description: What you could not verify, and why.
